live_deflection.definition: Terminal Tickets with no agent touch — no user-authored Message or Note. Credits AI handling and self-service only.

drift.note: Live deflection is -55.5% from AI-answered + Phantom (73.5%), past the 10% threshold. Advisory: the two sides are not the same Conversations — the accounted rate is measured over the committed synthetic Traffic, live deflection over real Widget traffic — so read this as the distance between those populations before reading it as a fault here.
